verdict.rationale: Airweave provides a shared MCP server that any MCP-compatible assistant (Claude, Cursor, other MCP clients) can connect to for unified search over synced data, and community evidence confirms it works with Cursor. However, ChatGPT is not natively an MCP client and no evidence shows a ChatGPT-specific connector or plugin path, so cross-tool 'same memory' coverage is not fully evidenced across all three named assistants. missing for 10: explicit ChatGPT integration/connector evidence, and independent confirmation that Claude/ChatGPT/Cursor simultaneously share one memory in practice.
